headline: Indian markets focus on WPI inflation, crude oil, and FII flows following a third straight week of gains.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian markets extended gains for a third straight week supported by foreign institutional investor (FII) buying.
Rotation trade out of AI stocks globally has helped fuel India's stock market comeback.
Key macro factors including upcoming WPI inflation data, crude oil prices, and FII trading activity will guide market direction this week.
Markets experienced some late-week profit taking with Sensex slipping 319 points and Nifty falling below 25,150.
whatHappening: Brokerages highlighted buy calls for stocks including Hero Motocorp, Bharti Airtel, and Indus Towers.
Key stocks in focus for trading today include Eicher Motors, Patanjali Foods, Godrej Industries, JSW Infra, and BEL.
Tech funding continues as Bharat Semi raised $24 million for AI sensors, and Oister Global launched a ₹600 crore deep-tech fund.
Primary market momentum remains visible as IPO activity warms up again.
summary: Indian equities enter the trading week after securing a third consecutive week of gains, supported by persistent FII inflows and rotation trades. Key market drivers for the week include WPI inflation data, crude oil movements, and FII flows. Stock-specific action is led by recommended buys such as Hero Motocorp and Bharti Airtel alongside active momentum in IPOs and startup funding.
